decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line changelog entry [ev-ea73ef1da3cb]. It says the UI now shows an error message when the maximum number of pods for viewing logs is reached. It does not say what the limit is, whether a setting or flag controls it, or what the UI did before the fix (for example, silently cutting off the logs or failing). Without that, there is no concrete subject and no exposure condition to write down for the two open aspects. That detail would have to come from PR #21725, which the entry only points to.
